QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Out of Time
QuestInfo.0: Ask Eremos where to go to continue your training.
QuestInfo.1: Ellin Forest seems to vibrate at a different frequency than the rest of Maple World. This location is a marvelous intersection of the past and present, where things of the past unfold as if for the first time. Eremos claims this place is ideal for training and asks that you defeat 1,500 monsters in Ellin Forest to collect remote data.
QuestInfo.2: The data you've collected proved very helpful to Eremos's research. Much about the future can be learned by studying the past, and Ellin Forest was the perfect setting to do that.
